DHA-84.purpose: Port of Entry Visa or Transit Visa (Form 11). Used to collect the traveller's identity, travel document, residence/contact information, South Africa visit details, host/contact details, admissibility/security declarations and transit information where applicable.

BI-947.purpose: Application for a Permanent Residence Permit (Form 18). Used for permanent residence applications under the categories/grounds set out in the form and accompanying requirements.

BI-1712A.purpose: Affidavit in respect of parties to a permanent spousal relationship (Form 12). Part A is for the initial application; Part B is for demonstrating the relationship continues two years after issuance of the visa/permit.
